title: Tournament Selection with VLM
description: After a batch completes, tournament ranks outputs via VLM relative ranking. Renders all candidates + reference in a labeled grid (VOYAGE-3), sends to VLM asking relative ranking questions (closest to reference, most interesting, most technically accomplished). Parses VLM JSON response into per-candidate scores, combines with Chamfer fitness as weighted score. Top-K become winners. Depends on VOYAGE-2 and VOYAGE-3.
definition-of-done: 1. Tournament accepts N candidate OBJ/DSL paths + reference. 2. Calls RenderGrid to produce labeled grid image. 3. Sends grid to VLM with structured ranking prompt. 4. Parses VLM response into per-candidate scores. 5. Combines VLM + Chamfer into weighted score. 6. Returns ranked candidates with top-K winners. 7. Handles VLM parse failures with retry.
testing-plan: 1. Run tournament with 4 known OBJs of varying quality against a reference. 2. Verify VLM response parses correctly. 3. Verify ranking correlates with visual quality. 4. Test retry logic with malformed VLM response.
